top_signals.title: Australia’s FireFly Metals Seeks $136 Million for Copper Project
top_signals.summary: Australian copper miner FireFly Metals Ltd. is seeking to raise A$190 million ($136 million) through a sale of new Australian and Canadian shares to develop its Green Bay project in Canada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Southeast Asia’s budget airlines eye recovery but fuel scars linger
top_signals.summary: Results from Malaysia's AirAsia, Singapore Airlines' budget arm Scoot and the Philippines' Cebu Pacific showed efforts to recoup soaring fuel costs through higher fares fell short.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
top_signals.summary: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: North Korea’s denuclearization absent from readouts of latest U.S.-South Korea talks
top_signals.summary: Questions have grown about Washington and Seoul's commitment to seeking to rid Pyongyang of its nukes after top diplomats' meeting.

top_signals.title: Bernstein sees new USDC growth cycle, sets $140 Circle price target
top_signals.summary: USDC supply increased by roughly $2 billion in seven days, with Bernstein citing higher transaction activity and several factors that could support further growth.
